statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial evaluation for sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was for continuous ambulatory monitoring
The diagnoses are I49.5 and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Services were rendered without obtaining the required authorization
